family_findings: The current GuiModule constructs and registers GuiCacheDebugComponent; its OnActivate body contains all three exact frozen registrations. Shared lifecycle registration reachability is covered by the separate 67-site proposal.

Two function actions toggle independent bools; RenderHUD gates their corresponding status readers. The display mode integer is registered by address, has five options and range 0..4, and filters only the resource-status panel.

The Apt panel reads per-flow expected component IDs and loaded flags; StateLoadingHelper source writers append expected IDs and mark matching entries loaded on Apt trigger notification. The resource panel reads each resource state through AppendResourceInfo; state-transition and load/unload notification writers are pinned.
No missing writer/reader body is identified for these three registrations in current source. All three original inventory behavior dispositions remain pending; this mapping is not a runtime verdict.
